articles.title: Man charged with attempted rape in Rochdale parks
articles.excerpt: A man has been charged with attempted rape following two alleged incidents in Rochdale parks. He is due to appear in court tomorrow.
articles.content_html:
A man has been charged with attempted rape after two alleged sex attacks in parks in Rochdale. Greater Manchester Police (GMP) reported that the incidents involving two women occurred in Broadfield Park and Milnrow Memorial Park on Saturday morning (July 25).

Harvey Symes, a 23-year-old black British national from Simeon Street, Milnrow, has been charged with two counts of attempted rape and making threats to kill.

He is due to appear at Manchester Magistrates Court tomorrow (Monday).

GMP continues to investigate the incidents, and anyone with information is encouraged to come forward.
